text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp.
Lured by the crisp morning air, I was taking
a stroll through the dawn with no destination in mind when—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I woke up rather early today.
So I figured I'd go for a stroll.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I walked with her for a while,
talking about nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day we had trouble drying our towels.
The night we caught a glimpse of fireworks from the dorm room window.
Yesterday, when I got a recipe from the cafeteria staff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —After wandering aimlessly for a while, I eventually reached the sea.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...The beach at this time of day is beautiful, isn't it?
Watching the morning light ebb and flow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I could stare at it forever...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It was truly unfortunate about your overseas challenge.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...It makes me almost wish I'd never noticed that path at all. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However,
we cannot afford to stop here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The place I must reach remains unchanged.
That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right. One step at a time.
Doing what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, let's start
by scoping out the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With renewed resolve.
And so, this year's summer training camp came to an end."
